info.title: Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery — PINNED CONTRACT (structure only)

x-websocket-endpoints.authentication: A bearer token is sent as a base64url-encoded bearer.<token> WebSocket subprotocol.
x-websocket-endpoints.resume: The since query parameter is the last durable event sequence received; reconnecting replays later saved events.
x-websocket-endpoints.audience: Role-addressed events follow the role the session has SELECTED, so a multi-role account receives a dispatcher-audience event only while acting as dispatcher.
